conviction_note: The FY26 period is effectively pre-released: the company said on 2026-08-28 that all of its planned balance-sheet deal revenue and profit was locked in, and no revision followed. The print therefore turns on the first FY27 guide. Management has signalled that guide will meet the mid-term-plan path, pointing to a slipped high-margin advisory deal and new acquisitions settling in October and November. The one IFIS analyst sits higher still (12-month-forward EPS 317, which implies net profit of about JPY1.65bn). The name sold its last full-year guide (+10% at the open, -5.85% at the close), and 228k shares of buy-only margin longs sit over it. Findings sum to +1.0; the scaled number is +0.6 (p_up 53 x abs 10). The scaled number is smaller because the sell-the-beat history and the single high analyst bar keep p_up near 50 while the move size stays large.
bar: FY26 (Aug) ordinary profit: company plan JPY1,044m (held since 2025-10-14; revenue raised to 7,000m on 2026-04-13, dividend raised to 30 yen on 2026-07-14) against the IFIS single-analyst consensus of JPY1,130m (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=276A, as of 2026-10-14). I expect about 1,060-1,100m, which is roughly -4% against IFIS and on or slightly above the company plan. FY27 bar: the mid-term plan's FY27 revenue of JPY7.7bn (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/382826). The FY27 operating-profit target is NOT sourced. The analyst's 12-month-forward EPS of 317.2 yen (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=276A) is a single-analyst number. The FY27 bar is therefore disputed, and the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% with no disclosed seller at or above 0.5% (baseline, as of 2026-10-14). The name is a buy-only 制度信用 stock, so margin shorts cannot exist and 売り残 is 0. Margin longs (買い残) stood at 228.2k shares on 10/09, rising from 211.5k on 09/11 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=276A). That is about 4.4% of the 5.19M shares outstanding and about 10 days of the ~22k-share average daily volume: a crowded leveraged retail long into the print. There is no skew (no options). priced_lean_pct is +0.03. The 20-day run-up is -0.62% and the 5-day is -6.05%. On 10-15 the stock was -3.0% by 09:56 JST while the Nikkei was -3.83% in a broad risk-off.

findings.finding: The first FY27 guide comes with this release, and management has pre-signalled it will meet or beat the mid-term-plan path. The July Q3 briefing said the pipeline is sufficient for the mid-term plan's FY27 operating-profit target. A high-margin advisory deal was moved out of FY26 into FY27, not lost. In the 2026-07-22 Q&A the company answered a question about upward revisions with '早期の中期経営計画達成' and said FY27 sales would centre on balance-sheet investment deals. Three new purchases of property for resale settle on 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-06: Fukuoka at no less than 30% of FY25 net assets, and two Yamanashi properties together at no less than 30%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the last full-year print (2025-10-14, after the close) the FY26 guide was +80% operating profit plus the new mid-term plan. The stock opened +10% (7,520 against 6,840), closed -5.85%, fell another 5.75% and 4.28% over the next two sessions, and a public offering followed on 2025-10-30. At Q3 (2026-07-14) a dividend raise plus confidence in the full-year plan gave +12.27%. At Q2 (2026-04-13) a revenue upgrade with a weak quarter gave -13.18%.
findings.why_not_priced: At JPY20.7bn market cap the stock trades at 13x the one analyst's forward EPS and about 16x a mid-term-path FY27 net profit of roughly JPY1.3bn. A believed guide at or above the plan path would put it above the 4,300-4,400 seen in late September and early October. Instead it is -6% over five days. One analyst covers it and there is no FY27 consensus beyond that one number. The risk to this finding is that the guide lands between the mid-term path and the analyst, which this name has sold before.
findings.independence: Separate documents point the same way. The 2026-09-25 acquisition notices (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540071/, https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260925/140120260925540077/) show the FY27 deal pipeline. The Q3 transcript (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/385393) carries the FY27 operating-profit statement. Peer read-through: 霞ヶ関キャピタル (3498, also an August year-end) rose 9.89% on 2026-10-07 after its FY results and FY27 dividend-raise guide (Yahoo chart 3498.T; a proxy only).

findings.finding: FY26 results are locked near plan. On 2026-08-28 the company announced the Okayama sale had closed in Q4 and said all FY26 balance-sheet deal revenue and profit is confirmed. It filed no 業績予想の修正 between 07-14 and the print. Q1 and Q3 operating profit beat the quarterly plan and Q2 missed. The one IFIS analyst expects ordinary profit of 1,130 against the company's 1,044. The company landed 9% below its final revised operating-profit figure last year, because an 80m brokerage fee slipped.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 actual operating profit was 612 against a final revised 672. The stock still opened +10% on the guide that day before closing -5.85%, so the guide dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company has said the year is locked and the Q4 plan is public. The only residual is the gap between the company number and the single analyst's 1,130 ordinary.
findings.independence: The kabuyoho revision history (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=276A) shows FY26 ordinary profit held at 1,044 through 07-14. The Q3 transcript said all Q4 contracts were signed and waiting on settlement. Both are the company's own statements, so they are not independent of the source.

findings.finding: FY27 dividend guide. Management stated a policy of growing the dividend with profit (20, then 22, 27 and 30 yen; raised by 3 yen at Q3). A higher FY27 dividend will very likely be announced with the results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 dividend raise (27 to 30 yen, 2026-07-14) came with +12.27% the next session, together with confidence in the full-year plan. The yield is only 0.75%, so the dividend alone moves little.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely expected given the stated policy. What is not priced is the size: at a payout near 20%, a mid-term-path FY27 net profit implies a dividend of about 45-50 yen, against 30 yen today.
findings.independence: The kabuyoho dividend history (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportDps?bcode=276A) shows 22 then 30 yen and a 19.9% payout. It is the same company policy, so not independent.

findings.finding: There is a crowded leveraged long and no short side. The stock is buy-only under 制度信用. Margin longs were 228.2k shares on 10/09 and rising steadily (211.5k on 09/11), about 4.4% of shares and about 10 days of volume, while margin shorts are 0 and disclosed shorts are 0.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 4 of the last 5 estimated print reactions were down (-15.48, -5.85, -10.06, -13.18; +12.27 the exception). The FY25 print reversed a +10% open into a -5.85% close.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance is public. What it adds is asymmetry: a guide that falls short of the high analyst bar meets forced or leveraged sellers with no shorts to cover. If it were priced, margin longs would be shrinking into the print; they grew for four weeks.
findings.independence: The baseline's JPX register (0.0%, no sellers) confirms there is no short fuel on the other side. It is a different source.

findings.finding: Macro risk-off on the event day. The Nikkei was -3.83% at 09:55 JST on 10-15 on renewed fears of early US rate hikes, and 276A was -3.04% by 09:56. Shareholders of this leveraged property name have repeatedly asked about rate sensitivity, and the company calls the impact limited.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced: the window starts at today's close, which already holds today's fall. Only a follow-through on 10-16 counts, and that is macro-to-company transmission, a hypothesis.
findings.independence: The kabuyoho market headline '日経平均は863円安でスタート' (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=276A) shows the same macro day. It is the same fact.

outside_window.finding: Kumamoto logistics development: a consolidated TMK, 60% owned, took a JPY4.38bn non-recourse Higo Bank loan executed 2026-08-31. The company says it has no FY26 impact, and any sale or profit lands in a later year.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none expected for FY26; the company said on 08-28 that all balance-sheet deal profit is locked and filed no revision. Returns: a higher FY27 dividend is likely under the stated policy of growing the dividend with profit; no buyback history. New-year guide: the decisive item; the mid-term plan path is FY27 revenue 7.7bn (operating-profit target unsourced), management signalled it will be met, and the single IFIS analyst is higher (forward EPS 317). Quarter against own 進捗率 history: 9M ordinary progress was 50.8% against 79.5% at FY25's Q3, but FY26 was planned Q4-heavy (Q4 revenue of about 3.9bn), so this is not a miss signal.
baseline_tension: The positive lean (a strong FY27 guide pre-signalled, a dividend raise likely) cuts against the -6% five-day run-in and the risk-off tape, and it is hedged by this name's habit of selling a strong full-year guide. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY27 guide above the mid-term path plus a dividend near 45-50 yen. I looked for both and filed them; the negatives are positioning and macro, not a visible miss.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on 月次 or a public 進捗率) does not apply because no finding rests on a visible miss; rule 2 (check the sign, look for the strongest positive) was already done in baseline_tension, and the draft leans positive, so p_up stays at 53
